Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Selected surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected surah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SELECTED SURAH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Selected surah helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SELECTED SURAH
Study Selected surah like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.

1. Read the idea carefully: Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons).

PUT IT TOGETHER

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Selected surah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons))

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Selected surah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons).
3. Practise this skill: Use the selected surah in  Learners use flashcards and a pocket board to Swalah. sort and arrange the verses of the selected Surah.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Selected surah from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Selected surah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Selected surah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. Know what Selected surah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
